name: Western Tien-Shan
description: Spanning Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, Western Tien-Shan covers a stretch of one of the world's great mountain systems, climbing from about 700 metres to peaks of 4,503 metres. Its slopes shift from foothills to varied forests and rare plant communities. It is also a birthplace of many cultivated fruit crops, so wild ancestors of familiar orchard fruits still grow here.
